purpose: Index for public-safe GitHub storage of PMP app-layer lossless quality and Inventory Eyes reports.
writer_name_warning: Do not call this Safe Writer. Safe Writer is already a separate PMP app/code-writing tool.
writer_role: Vault GitHub Writer writes public-safe Inventory Eyes / Lossless Quality reports into the PMP Lossless Inventory Vault.
privacy_rules: Only public app structure, inventory metadata, route status, theme/status findings, and localStorage key names are allowed.

attachment_model.role: support vault for app cleanup, lossless quality, Inventory Eyes, and version-control reports
attachment_model.resident_use: Resident may read this as app-layer context for lossless quality, but must not treat it as private memory or master truth.

mode_1_shortcut_automatic.name: PMP Vault GitHub Shortcut
mode_1_shortcut_automatic.flow: App creates PMP_LOSSLESS_VAULT_WRITE_PACKET -> app copies packet to clipboard -> app opens Shortcut -> Shortcut reads clipboard -> Shortcut writes packet.report to current.json through GitHub API.
mode_1_shortcut_automatic.token_location: Private iPhone Shortcut only; never public app HTML or public JavaScript.

mode_2_chatgpt_connector.name: ChatGPT GitHub Connector Writer
mode_2_chatgpt_connector.flow: App creates packet -> user uploads/sends packet to ChatGPT -> ChatGPT uses GitHub connector as Vault GitHub Writer -> current.json is updated.

write_model.preferred_flow_now: Improve Lossless Quality creates report -> Copy Lossless Report creates a PMP_LOSSLESS_VAULT_WRITE_PACKET -> app opens PMP Vault GitHub Writer Shortcut -> Shortcut writes packet.report to current_report.
write_model.fallback_flow: If Shortcut fails, upload/send the packet to ChatGPT and ChatGPT writes packet.report to current_report through the GitHub connector.
allowed_writers: PMP Vault GitHub Shortcut controlled by the user
ChatGPT GitHub connector action approved by user
other private authenticated writer controlled by the user
not_allowed_writers: public GitHub Pages HTML containing a token
public JavaScript containing a GitHub token
any writer that stores private Bug Memory in this vault

next_step: Create the iPhone Shortcut named PMP Vault GitHub Writer. It must read the clipboard packet, verify privacy gate, and write packet.report to pmp-lossless-inventory-vault/current.json.
